header: CN 106008290 A   权 利 要 求 书   1/2 页

paragraphs.zh: 1.本发明提供了一种环磺酮的制备方法，其特征在于，包括以下步骤：
paragraphs.en: 1. The present invention provides a process for preparing tembotrione (环磺酮), characterised in that it comprises the following steps:
paragraphs.notes: TRANSCRIPTION CONVENTION for this page, following the reference run: the scan is typeset with condensed punctuation glyphs and with spacing inserted at CJK/Latin boundaries. Those gaps are kerning artifacts, not characters, and are closed in the zh fields; no character was added, removed or substituted. Punctuation is reproduced as printed after glyph-by-glyph magnification: full-width 、，；。：in prose, half-width , - ( ) : inside Latin/numeral runs (so 1.1-1.2:1 and 1,3- keep half-width forms). This is the claims page, so paragraphs carry printed claim numbers, not [00NN] markers. 环磺酮 is the accepted Chinese common name for tembotrione and is glossed that way throughout this file; the Chinese is kept verbatim. Note the claim is drafted as 本发明提供了 ("the present invention provides"), which is description phrasing inside claim 1.

paragraphs.zh: 步骤a：以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸甲酯与三氟乙醇钠为反应底物，加入MOH或M2CO3，在反应溶剂中进行反应，获得2-氯-3-三氟乙氧甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸，具体化学反应式如下式(1)所示：
paragraphs.en: Step a: using methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate and sodium trifluoroethoxide as the reaction substrates, adding MOH or M2CO3, and carrying out the reaction in a reaction solvent to obtain 2-chloro-3-(trifluoroethoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; the specific chemical reaction equation is as shown in equation (1) below:
paragraphs.notes: MOH and M2CO3 are printed without subscripts, as plain M2CO3. 甲磺基 is used throughout where standard Chinese nomenclature would write 甲磺酰基 (methanesulfonyl); translated as methanesulfonyl because the drawing shows SO2CH3 attached directly to the ring. 三氟乙氧甲基 carries no locants; the drawing shows CH2OCH2CF3, i.e. a (2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl group, but the locants are supplied by the drawing and not by this text. The prose names the substrate as the methyl ester and the product as the free acid, so an ester cleavage is implied but never stated in words; the drawing does show CH3OH as a byproduct.

paragraphs.zh: 步骤b：以步骤a的2-氯-3-三氟乙氧甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸与1,3-环己二酮为反应底物，在缩合剂和碱催化剂的作用下，在反应溶剂中进行缩合反应，获得环磺酮，具体化学反应式如下式(2)所示：
paragraphs.en: Step b: using the 2-chloro-3-(trifluoroethoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid from step a and 1,3-cyclohexanedione as the reaction substrates, carrying out a condensation reaction in a reaction solvent under the action of a condensing agent and a base catalyst to obtain tembotrione; the specific chemical reaction equation is as shown in equation (2) below:

paragraphs.zh: 其中，所述步骤a中，M为Li、Na、K离子中的一种。
paragraphs.en: Wherein, in said step a, M is one of the Li, Na and K ions.
paragraphs.notes: Drawing (1) writes the specific byproduct NaBr, which presumes the sodium salt; the text here allows Li, Na or K.

paragraphs.zh: 2.根据权利要求1所述的一种环磺酮的制备方法，其特征在于，所述步骤a中，三氟乙醇钠与2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸甲酯的摩尔比为1.1-1.2:1。
paragraphs.en: 2. The process for preparing tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that, in said step a, the molar ratio of sodium trifluoroethoxide to methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate is 1.1-1.2:1.

paragraphs.zh: 3.根据权利要求1所述的一种环磺酮的制备方法，其特征在于，所述步骤a中，MOH/M2CO3与2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸甲酯的摩尔比为1-1.5:1。
paragraphs.en: 3. The process for preparing tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that, in said step a, the molar ratio of MOH/M2CO3 to methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate is 1-1.5:1.
paragraphs.notes: Printed with a line break inside the token, as MOH/ at the end of one line and M2CO3 at the start of the next; the solidus is as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 4.根据权利要求1所述的一种环磺酮的制备方法，其特征在于，所述步骤a中，反应温度为0-5℃，反应时间为2-10小时。
paragraphs.en: 4. The process for preparing tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that, in said step a, the reaction temperature is 0-5℃ and the reaction time is 2-10 hours.

paragraphs.zh: 5.根据权利要求1所述的一种环磺酮的制备方法，其特征在于，所述步骤b中，1,3-环己二酮与2-氯-3-三氟乙氧甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸的摩尔比为1-1.3:1；所述碱催化剂与2-氯-3-三氟乙氧甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸的摩尔比为1-3:1；所述缩合剂与2-氯-3-三氟乙氧甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸的摩尔比为1-2:1。
paragraphs.en: 5. The process for preparing tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that, in said step b, the molar ratio of 1,3-cyclohexanedione to 2-chloro-3-(trifluoroethoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid is 1-1.3:1; the molar ratio of said base catalyst to 2-chloro-3-(trifluoroethoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid is 1-3:1; the molar ratio of said condensing agent to 2-chloro-3-(trifluoroethoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid is 1-2:1.

paragraphs.zh: 6.根据权利要求1所述的一种环磺酮的制备方法，其特征在于，所述步骤b中，碱催化剂选自碳酸钠、碳酸钾、氢氧化钙、三乙胺、吡啶中的一种或多种。
paragraphs.en: 6. The process for preparing tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that, in said step b, the base catalyst is selected from one or more of sodium carbonate, potassium carbonate, calcium hydroxide, triethylamine and pyridine.

paragraphs.zh: 7.根据权利要求1所述的一种环磺酮的制备方法，其特征在于，所述步骤b中，缩合剂选自CDI、HBTU、HOBT、DBU中的一种或多种，其中，CDI为N,N'-羰基二咪唑，HBTU为O-苯并三氮唑-四甲基脲六氟磷酸酯，HOBT为1-羟基苯并三唑，DBU为1,8-二氮杂二环十一碳-7-烯。
paragraphs.en: 7. The process for preparing tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that, in said step b, the condensing agent is selected from one or more of CDI, HBTU, HOBT and DBU, wherein CDI is N,N'-carbonyldiimidazole, HBTU is O-benzotriazol-tetramethyluronium hexafluorophosphate, HOBT is 1-hydroxybenzotriazole, and DBU is 1,8-diazabicycloundec-7-ene.
paragraphs.notes: The apostrophe in N,N'- is printed as a right single quotation mark. 苯并三氮唑 (claim 7, HBTU) and 苯并三唑 (claim 7, HOBT) are two different spellings of benzotriazole in the same sentence; both are transcribed as printed. 六氟磷酸酯 reads literally as "hexafluorophosphate ester"; HBTU is a hexafluorophosphate salt, not an ester, so the reading is translated literally as hexafluorophosphate. 十一碳-7-烯 is printed without the leading locants that 1,8- already supplies.

paragraphs.zh: 8.根据权利要求1所述的一种环磺酮的制备方法，其特征在于，所述步骤b中，缩合反应的温度为-10-30℃，反应时间为0.5-12h。
paragraphs.en: 8. The process for preparing tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that, in said step b, the temperature of the condensation reaction is -10-30℃ and the reaction time is 0.5-12h.
paragraphs.notes: -10-30℃ is printed as a single run of hyphens; read literally it is the range from -10℃ to 30℃, but the printed form is ambiguous and is transcribed exactly as it appears.

paragraphs.zh: 9.根据权利要求1所述的一种环磺酮的制备方法，其特征在于，所述步骤a或/和步骤b中，反应溶剂为己烷、环己烷、N,N-二甲基甲酰胺、苯、甲苯、二甲苯、二氯甲烷、1,2-二氯乙烷、氯仿、1,4-二氧六环、乙醚、四氢呋喃、乙腈中的一种或多种。
paragraphs.en: 9. The process for preparing tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that, in said step a or/and step b, the reaction solvent is one or more of hexane, cyclohexane, N,N-dimethylformamide, benzene, toluene, xylene, dichloromethane, 1,2-dichloroethane, chloroform, 1,4-dioxane, diethyl ether, tetrahydrofuran and acetonitrile.
paragraphs.notes: 或/和 is printed as written ("or/and"); translated literally rather than as "and/or". 己烷 and 环己烷 are distinguished carefully in the scan: the first is 己 without the enclosing 环.

paragraphs.zh: 10.根据权利要求1所述的一种环磺酮的制备方法，其特征在于，所述反应溶剂与2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸甲酯或2-氯-3-三氟乙氧甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸的重量比为2-8:
paragraphs.en: 10. The process for preparing tembotrione according to claim 1, characterised in that the weight ratio of said reaction solvent to methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate or to 2-chloro-3-(trifluoroethoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid is 2-8:
paragraphs.notes: Claim 10 is cut off at the page break. The last thing printed on this page is 2-8: with nothing after the colon; the remainder of the ratio continues on page 3 (权利要求书 2/2页). Nothing was supplied to complete it.

drawings.notes: Equation (1) of claim 1, step a. One arrow, single step. Nothing at all is written below the arrow; MOH/M2CO3 is above it, and the M2 is printed with a subscript 2 in the drawing (unlike the prose, which prints M2CO3 flat). CF3CH2ONa sits to the left of the arrow as a co-reactant on the substrate side, not above or below it, and is recorded as a structure rather than as an arrow reagent for that reason. The scheme converts the methyl ester to the free acid as well as displacing the bromide, which is why CH3OH appears as a byproduct. The two written byproducts and the co-reactant are line formulae, not drawn structures; they are recorded in structures so nothing on the page is lost. Compound labels I and II are printed in small roman numerals beneath the two drawn structures.

drawings.notes: Equation (2) of claim 1, step b. One arrow, single step. Above and below the arrow are different: 缩合剂 above, 碱催化剂 below, separated by a horizontal rule drawn over the arrow shaft. Neither is named to a specific chemical here; claims 6 and 7 supply the lists. IV is drawn in the 2-acyl-1,3-diketone (keto) form: three separate C=O groups, no enol OH and no double bond drawn in the cyclohexanedione ring. The tautomer is therefore as drawn, not inferred. IV is the compound the claims call 环磺酮; the drawn skeleton is tembotrione.

discrepancies.what: Equation (1) writes the two byproducts explicitly; the prose of step a mentions no byproduct at all.
discrepancies.drawing_says: product II is accompanied by + CH3OH + NaBr
discrepancies.text_says: 在反应溶剂中进行反应，获得2-氯-3-三氟乙氧甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸 (nothing about CH3OH or NaBr)

discrepancies.what: The bromide byproduct in the drawing is specifically the sodium salt, while the text lets M be any of three alkali metals.
MOH/M2CO3 is set with a subscript in the drawing but flat in the prose, so the prose reading of the stoichiometry is not typographically determined.
discrepancies.drawing_says: MOH/M2CO3 above the arrow, with a subscript 2 on M
discrepancies.text_says: 加入MOH或M2CO3 and, in claim 3, MOH/M2CO3, both printed without subscripts

discrepancies.what: Equation (2) writes water as a byproduct of the condensation; the prose of step b does not.
discrepancies.drawing_says: product IV is accompanied by + H2O
discrepancies.text_says: 在反应溶剂中进行缩合反应，获得环磺酮 (no byproduct named)

discrepancies.what: The locants of the trifluoroethoxy group come only from the drawing; the Chinese name omits them.
